API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPartner IntegrationsGet Aws Account Summary
Get Aws Account Summary
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/publicCloudInfo/lite

Retrieves basic information about the AWS cloud accounts. For additional details, use the GET /publicCloudInfo method.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
cloudType
string

Possible values: [AWS, AZURE, GCP]

The cloud type. The default and mandatory value is AWS.

Default value: AWS
search
string

The search string.

page
int32

Specifies the page offset.

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size.

Default value: 250
Responses
​
default

Defaultresponse. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

A unique identifier for the public cloud.

name
string

The name of your AWS account.

accountId
string

The AWS account ID where workloads are deployed.

cloudType
string

The cloud type. The default and mandatory value is AWS.

Possible values: [AWS, AZURE, GCP]

]
